description: This file defines an admin controller class 'Translation' in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages event hooks related to translation data by adding tasks for generating, editing, or deleting translation information. The class interacts with the 'setting/task' model to enqueue these tasks based on specific event triggers, identified in the code comments.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Controller class handling events related to translation data updates in the admin area, responsible for enqueuing tasks for adding, editing, or deleting translation information.

methods.name: addTranslation
methods.description: Handles the event of adding a new translation by enqueuing a task to generate translation info.

methods.name: editTranslation
methods.description: Handles the event of editing an existing translation by enqueuing a task to update translation info.

methods.name: deleteTranslation
methods.description: Handles the event of deleting a translation by enqueuing a task to process translation deletion.
